ADMINISTRATOR.label: Administrator
ADMINISTRATOR.description: Has every permission and always sees every channel. Still can’t manage higher roles.

MANAGE_SERVER.label: Manage server
MANAGE_SERVER.description: Change the name, picture and welcome channel; see and revoke invites.

MANAGE_ROLES.label: Manage roles
MANAGE_ROLES.description: Create, edit, delete and give the roles below one’s own highest role.

MANAGE_CHANNELS.label: Manage channels
MANAGE_CHANNELS.description: Create, edit, delete and arrange channels and categories; turn on the Task Board; set up rooms.

CREATE_INVITE.label: Create invites
CREATE_INVITE.description: Make links to invite friends to the server.

MODERATE_MEMBERS.label: Time out members
MODERATE_MEMBERS.description: Someone timed out can only look and read: no messages, no reactions, no rooms.

KICK_MEMBERS.label: Kick members
KICK_MEMBERS.description: Someone kicked can come back with a new invite.

BAN_MEMBERS.label: Ban members
BAN_MEMBERS.description: Ban, unban and see the ban list.

VIEW_CHANNEL.label: View channels
VIEW_CHANNEL.description: See channels and read every message, old ones included.

ADD_REACTIONS.label: Add reactions
ADD_REACTIONS.description: Add a new reaction to a message. Clicking one already there doesn’t need this.

MANAGE_MESSAGES.label: Manage messages
MANAGE_MESSAGES.description: Delete others’ messages, pin messages, post in channels where only message managers may post.

MANAGE_STUDY_ROOMS.label: Manage study rooms
MANAGE_STUDY_ROOMS.description: Control every shared study session; change study room settings.

MANAGE_TASKS.label: Manage tasks
MANAGE_TASKS.description: Edit, delete and change the status of every task.

members.empty: No one has this role yet.
members.handoutLocked: You need every permission of this role to add or remove people
members.removeSelfBody: You have Manage roles through this role. Once it’s removed, you can’t open the Roles page any more.

addDialog.title: Add to {{role}}
addDialog.failed: Couldn’t add them. The list was reloaded; try again.

dialog.timeoutBody: {{name}} can still read messages but can’t send any, react or join a room.
dialog.kickBody: {{name}} can come back with a new invite.
dialog.banBody: {{name}} is removed from the server and can’t come back with any invite until unbanned.
dialog.failed: Couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.
dialog.outranked: {{name}} now has a role equal to or above yours, so you can’t do this.
dialog.gone: {{name}} is no longer in the server.
dialog.admin: {{name}} has Administrator, so they can’t be timed out. Remove that role first.

bans.description: Banned people can’t come back with any invite. Once unbanned, they can join again with a valid invite.
bans.emptyBody: People banned from the Members page will show here.
bans.confirmBody: {{name}} can join the server again with a valid invite.
bans.failed: Couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.

leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.body: You will need a new invite to come back.
leave.offline: Couldn’t leave the server · Check your connection and try again

ownerLeave.title: Transfer ownership before leaving
ownerLeave.body: You own {{name}}. Transfer ownership to another member before you leave.

alone.title: You are the only member
alone.body: Nobody else is in {{name}}, so there is no one to transfer it to. If you no longer use it, delete it.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: Choose who will own {{name}}. You keep the roles you have.
transfer.aloneBody: Invite friends first, or delete the server if you no longer use it.
transfer.timedOut: Timed out until {{time}} · Remove the timeout to choose them
transfer.confirmBody: {{name}} will have every permission, deleting the server included. You keep your roles, but can’t take ownership back unless {{name}} transfers it again.

refused.timed_out: {{name}} is timed out. Remove the timeout, then try again.
refused.gone: {{name}} is no longer in the server.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body_one: The server goes for its {{count}} member, with every channel, message and task. This can’t be undone.
delete.body_other: The server goes for all {{count}} members, with every channel, message and task. This can’t be undone.
delete.offline: You need a connection to delete the server. Check your connection and try again.
delete.renamed: The server was renamed meanwhile. Type its new name to confirm.

deletionBlocked.title: Hand over your servers first
deletionBlocked.body_one: You own {{count}} server that has other members. Hand it over (or delete it), then delete your account.
deletionBlocked.body_other: You own {{count}} servers that have other members. Hand them over (or delete them), then delete your account.
